what: Caps a single charge amount to 50000 cents before processing.
why: Downstream ledger stores amounts in int columns that overflow above 50000 cents; the cap prevents overflow until the ledger is migrated to bigint.
revisit_condition: When the ledger migration to bigint (ticket PAY-240) is completed.
anchor_snippet:
# HACK: cap single charge to 50000 cents due to a downstream ledger
if amount > 50000:
    logger.warning("capping charge amount from %d to 50000", amount)
    amount = 50000
